description.value: The North Thompson Sportsplex is a municipal recreation facility in Clearwater, BC, situated in the heart of Wells Gray Country. It features a covered regulation-sized ice rink used for both ice and dry-floor events, with locker rooms and spectator viewing platforms. Operated by the District of Clearwater, it serves both local athletes and visitors to the region.
